This Skin Renewing Peel is designed to help improve skin tone and texture by sloughing off dead skin cells and revealing more radiant, younger-looking skin. Lactic acid is a known gentle method of exfoliation suitable for all skin types, especially those with normal to dry, dehydrated or sun-damaged skin. When the layer of dead skin cells is physically decreased, so is the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles. Our melon super antioxidants help protect from environmental aggressors and prevent future damage.

Massage gently onto clean, dry skin. Leave on for 5 to 10 minutes. You may feel a slight tingling sensation during or after application. Wash thoroughly with warm water.

Use once or twice a week.

  • Reduces appearance of fine lines and wrinkles
  • Helps reveal renewed, more radiant skin
